subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: For malformed text that opens `<think>` and contains `<final>` without a closing `</think>`, should strict delivery return only the final body, suppress the payload, or keep the existing recovery fallback?
rationale: The source-level issue is clear, but the permanent behavior is a security/message-loss boundary shared by all channels and should not be chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Prefer final body when present
options.body: Treat `<final>` as the visible boundary for this malformed shape, strip the reasoning prefix, and add regression tests for sanitizer and WhatsApp delivery.

options.title: Suppress malformed strict payloads
options.body: Return empty text for unclosed `<think>` in strict delivery even when a final tag appears, prioritizing no reasoning leak over answer recovery.

options.title: Keep current recovery fallback
options.body: Accept the current leak risk to preserve text after malformed open tags, and document the behavior as intentional.

recommendation.title: Prefer final body when present
recommendation.body: Treat `<final>` as the visible boundary for this malformed shape, strip the reasoning prefix, and add regression tests for sanitizer and WhatsApp delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The fallback behavior and several recent shared sanitizer changes trace to this owner, making them the best available reviewer for strict-mode semantics.
